_about: Z32: gamble-house TaiSai (CGambleDiceTaiSaiObject), slot-machine and gamble-object packets read in the 2016 zone code (zone-pdb export, NA2016 Zone.pdb names) and checked against the 2016 client MHDiceGameTask handlers; offsets are payload offsets.

0xbc65.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_GAME_JOIN_ACK
fields: ticks left if status BETTING else 0; client reads low u16 /10
never written (stale buffer, Z32-B3); client does not read

0xbc67.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_GAME_BETTING_INFO_CMD
fields: bit0 first part, bit1 last part
{u16 nPlayerHnd, u32 nBetting, u32 nMoney}, 10 bytes each

0xbc69.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_GAME_LEAVE_ACK
0xbc69.basis: zone FUN_0061b020 (GDTSO_ExcuteLeaveGame; also the 0xBC68 handler, Z06 §4.4); client FUN_00706390
fields: 0x2620 left (client closes the TaiSai window); 0x2621-0x2627 refusals

0xbc6a.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_GAME_LEAVE_CMD
fields: 1 = leaves at the end of the round

0xbc77.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DICE_ROLL_CMD
fields: 0x2660 rolling (client state 2); 0x2661 not in game, 0x2662 no record, 0x2663 coins < own stakes, 0x2664 inventory lock busy (stakes not settled); client ignores non-0x2660

0xbc78.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DB_DICE_ROLL_RESULT_REQ
fields: NPC vt 0x344; the 0xBC79 handler re-checks it
GDT_DiceRollApplyResult {u16 nError (0 in the request, 0x2680 ok in the answer), u16 lockindex, u32 nPlayerNo, i64 nTotalDividend (net coins)}, 0x10 each

0xbc79.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DB_DICE_ROLL_RESULT_ACK
0xbc79.basis: zone FUN_0061d930, FUN_0061a180, FUN_0061ad40; character FUN_00421a30
fields: NPC vt 0x344; the 0xBC79 handler re-checks it

GDT_DiceRollApplyResult {u16 nError (0 in the request, 0x2680 ok in the answer), u16 lockindex, u32 nPlayerNo, i64 nTotalDividend (net coins)}, 0x10 each; per-result nError 0x2680 -> coins applied, else the lock is freed

0xbc7a.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DB_DICE_ROLL_RESULT_LOG_CMD
fields: NPC vt 0x344; the 0xBC79 handler re-checks it
{u32 nPlayerNo, u32 nBetting, u32 nBettingMoney, u16 nBattingRate (DividendRate or 0), u8 bStatus (1 won), u16 nSysRate, u32 nDividendMoney (after the cut)}, 0x15 each, one per gamer and staked kind

0xbc7b.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DICE_ROLL_RESULT_CMD
fields: 0x2670 (client: state 3, dice animation); 0x2671 not in game

0xbc7c.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_DICE_ROLL_RESULT_EMOTION_CMD
0xbc7c.basis: zone FUN_0061ad40 (BroadEmotion_DiceRoll, to the whole map); client FUN_00706d30
fields: {u16 nGamerHnd, u32 nEmotion = GBEventCode WinCode/LoseCode}, 6 each

0xbc7f.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_LARGE_AMOUNT_CMD
fields: {u16 nGamerHnd, u32 nMoney (low dword of nTotalDividend)}, 6 each; client announces text 0x4746208a

0xbc81.name: NC_GAMBLE_DICE_TAISAI_TIMER_CMD
fields: CastTime ticks (0 on stop); client does not read

0xbcc9.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_GAME_JOIN_ACK
0xbcc9.basis: zone FUN_0061e400 / FUN_00620b80 (go_SendGameInfo) / FUN_0061efc0 (sms_PlayerReady); client FUN_0071b370; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: coins per bet unit (GBSMBetCoin) on 0x28C0; error answers leave it unwritten (stale gpp bytes, Z32-B25)
0x28C0 ok; 0x28C1 in a game / enter failed, 0x28C2 no field, 0x28C3 lock pending, 0x28C4 no object, 0x28C5 too far, 0x28C6 full, 0x28C7 seat, 0x28D9 not on a screen; client acts only on 0x28C0

0xbccb.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_GAME_LEAVE_ACK
fields: 0x28C8 ok, 0x28C9 no field, 0x28CA lock pending, 0x28CB not at a slot machine

0xbccc.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_START_REQ
0xbccc.basis: zone FUN_00625340 (SMS_StopButton reads the stored bet) / FUN_006228f0; 2016 Zone.pdb SLOTMACHINE_BettingLine

0xbccd.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_START_ACK
0xbccd.basis: zone FUN_0061e870 / FUN_0061f540 (SMS_Start); also the settlement answer FUN_00620560 / FUN_0061f6e0; client FUN_0071afd0
fields: start: 0x28CF ok, 0x28D0 not READY, 0x28D1 too few coins, 0x28CE no screen; settlement: 0x28CF booked, 0x28D7 not STOPPING, 0x28CE no screen, 0x2901-0x2906 DB error; client: 0x28CF spins, other codes reset, only while a start is pending

0xbccf.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_STOPBUTTON_ACK
fields: 0x28D2 ok (client shows the screen); 0x28CD not a screen, 0x28CE no screen, 0x28D3 not rolling, 0x28D6 no lock list: screen bytes uninitialised (Z32-B19), client ignores

0xbcd1.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_WHEELSTOP_ACK
0xbcd1.basis: zone FUN_0061eaf0 / FUN_0061f930 (SMS_WheelStop3); client FUN_0071b090 / FUN_0071c480; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: 0x28D4 ok, 0x28D7 not STOPPING (rest zero), 0x28CE no screen (2-byte answer)
stake (unit x line units); client does not read it
payout after tax incl. jackpot share
byte0 bits 0-7 lines _789 _456 _123 _741 _852 _963 _753 _951; byte1 bit0 all, bit1 bonus, bit2 jackpot

0xbcd3.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_DB_RESULT_REQ
0xbcd3.basis: zone FUN_00625340 (SMS_StopButton); character FUN_004251a0; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: 9 symbols '0'+v in key order 1-9 (row 2, row 1, row 0) + NUL
zone pool of the machine type after this spin (0 after a jackpot)
payout incl. jackpot share, after tax

0xbcd4.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_DB_RESULT_ACK
0xbcd4.basis: zone FUN_00620330 / FUN_00620560 / FUN_0061f6e0; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: lock index of the coin reservation

0xbcd5.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_DB_GAMEINFO_REQ
0xbcd5.basis: zone FUN_00626220 (smjpr_RankingReq, once at the GameDB link); 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: machine type 0-2 and its GBSMBetCoin unit

0xbcd6.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_DB_GAMEINFO_ACK
fields: 0x2940 ok; anything else stops the zone (Z32-B23)
DB jackpot pool of that BetUnit; becomes the zone pool

0xbcd8.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_JACKPOTINFO_CMD
0xbcd8.basis: zone FUN_0061fe80 / FUN_0061fd70; client FUN_0071b0d0 / FUN_0071c3c0; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: per machine type: unit (client label chosen by 10/100/500) and GB_JPSaveRate x pool / 1000

0xbcda.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_JACKPOTRANKING_ACK
0xbcda.basis: zone FUN_0061ec60 / FUN_00620ef0 / FUN_0061ff80; client FUN_0071b820; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: no 50 cap in 2016 (Z32-B21); 0 when not at a screen
{Name5 name; u32 money = jackpot win}, sorted by money descending

0xbcdc.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_WINRANKING_ACK
0xbcdc.basis: zone FUN_0061ed90 / FUN_00624520 / FUN_00624710; client FUN_0071b790; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: {Name5 name; u32 money = winning spins since the join} of the players seated at machines of the same type, descending

0xbcdd.name: NC_GAMBLE_SLOTMACHINE_SOMEONE_GET_JACKPOT_CMD
0xbcdd.basis: zone FUN_00620410 (so_ply_IBurstJackPot, so_AllInMap); client FUN_0071b5b0; 2016 Zone.pdb struct
fields: the spin's win incl. jackpot share, before tax
